content: Garava dǝghwah kǝlaawa
“Ma kwahiin kǝ sarta, da gǝrav nǝ tlǝksǝra ghǝrazhigǝl dǝ dǝghwah kǝlaawa kwa kǝsarant kaaraha jahuramb da vaka dlǝgha zhiila ghuula.
Dlǝɓ ma iitǝra ar dlagaha, dlǝɓ dlaɓa ar ɗyamɗyama.
Ma sarta kwa kǝsarant nǝ dlagahaan kǝ kaaraha jahurambatǝra, kǝsarantbi kǝ wal vakaatǝr biya.
Lii ɗyamɗyamna kǝsarantkǝsǝg kǝ kaaraha jahuramb baz wal ma mǝrt vakaatǝra.
Zǝlamazǝlmǝg nǝ zhiila ghuulǝn lakwti sagauwa, kaa njitǝrnjiig kǝ haara, ngal ba tsǝtǝratsǝg kǝ haara.
“Ma kyakyaka avǝɗa, ngal cinngvacinng nǝ ɗaag taakiya, ‘Wanam zhiila ghuula! Asama sa dlǝghgaana.’
Kaa ba ciig kǝ dǝghwahaan kǝlaaw ǝmtaɗaatǝra, ar ɓadlǝna kǝ kaaraha jahurammbatǝra.
Am nǝ dlagahaan taa kǝ lii ɗyamɗyamna, ‘Gamkǝmndugǝg yaru kǝ wal ba hǝɗiikǝna, aɗaba naa ǝmtsǝg nǝ kaaraha jahurambamnda.’
Aiyam nǝ lii ɗyamɗyamǝn taa kǝ iitǝra, ‘Maaya, da tlǝkiyamaara biya. Ngulǝm dam da vak lii vǝlgaan am sǝgwa kǝ dǝgaruwa.’
Daral ba nǝ iitǝr da sǝgwa walna, lakwti saas kǝ iitǝra, sǝghaasǝg nǝ zhiila ghuula, kaa daas kǝ lii ɓadlarvǝghaɓadlǝg ǝmtaɗ dǝ iina da vaka hwaɗaga, kaa hǝɗvarduhǝɗǝg nǝ wakyagha.
“Tǝhalakwaha, kaa sǝgaasǝg kǝ dlaga dǝghwahaan dlǝɓna, am nǝ iitǝra, ‘Dadda ndannga, Dadda ndannga, wurkǝmndantwurg kǝ wakyagha!’
Kaa ngutǝrangug nǝ zhiilaghuulǝn taakiya, ‘Bak jiira wan tagkur naiya, Ən sǝrkur biya.’
“Mbakyarvad kwaha ndzamandzǝg ba ɓadlaɓadlana, aɗaba am sǝrgai kǝ faciya ma sart biya.
Garava kwanahah hǝkǝrɗa
“Tlǝksǝra Daadamazhigǝla band garava uudi kwada dagal dǝ dǝga, kaa ɗahtǝrǝt kǝ kwatnahaan fǝtǝrdǝm kǝ dǝgahaan da mizha dǝvaatǝra.
Vǝlar kǝ pall kǝ adawan alfu dlǝɓa, pall dlaɓ vǝlar kǝ adawan alfu buwa, vǝlar dlaɓ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ adawan alfu palla, makwaraatǝr vǝlghar ba kalkala ndzǝɗaana, Kaa dagalaana.
Kaa fǝgarzhafǝg kǝ dadda kwa cauwa adawan alfu dlǝɓǝn kǝ mbǝɗa dǝv bat watsǝra, kaa ba tlǝnatlǝg kǝ iin kǝ yu alfu dlǝɓ tuuk vakaiya.
Bandkwah dlaɓ dadda kwa cauwa adawan alfu buna, tlakǝna kǝ yu alfu bu tuuk vakaiya.
Kiyava dadda kwa cauwa adawan alfu pallǝna, nǝghǝghar bak kwaɗǝgakwaɗǝg kǝ affǝk hǝɗnan kǝ kwaɓa dadda hǝnyahaanǝna.
“Tǝhala zǝlmazǝlmǝga, kaa gwiyaghǝra saas kǝ dadda hǝnyaha kwatnahahaan kiyava sǝrgasǝrǝg kǝ dǝgiti ɓagara nǝ iitǝr dǝ kwaɓiina.
Kaa sagau kǝ dadda kwa cauwa adawan alfu dlǝɓǝn dǝ kwatlǝrǝn kǝ alfu dlǝɓa amaa, ‘Dadda hǝnyaha, adawan alfu dlǝɓ wa vǝlghwa nǝnnga. Wan nǝ yu alfu dlǝɓ naa tlǝkǝna nai tuuk vakaiya.’

Am nǝ dadda hǝnyahaan taa kǝ iina, ‘Uusa, kwatnaha jiijiira, kwa fǝvdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ vakaiya. Fǝvdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tsau dǝ kǝgh tǝghǝr kǝ zǝr dǝgit hǝdikǝna, ǝn da vǝlakvǝlǝg kǝ tlǝri juujig kwana. Asǝg sa dlaig ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya.’
“Kaa sagau kǝ dadda kwa cauwa alfu buwa adawana, amaa, ‘Dadda hǝnyaha, alfu buwa adawan wa vǝlghwa nǝnnga. Wan nǝ yu alfu bu naa tlǝkǝna nai tuuk vakaiya.’

Am nǝ dadda hǝnyahaan taa kǝ iina, ‘Uus, kwatnaha jiijiira, kwa fǝvdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tǝ vakaiya. Fǝvdǝghǝrǝtfǝg tsau dǝ kǝgh tǝghǝr kǝ dǝgit hǝdikǝna, ǝn da vǝlakvǝlǝg kǝ tlǝri juujig kwana. Asǝg sa dlaig ǝmtaɗ dǝ kaiya.’
“Kaa sagau kǝ dadda kwa cauwa alfu adawan pallna, amaa, ‘Dadda hǝnyaha, ǝn sǝrgasǝrg mbǝlɛmbǝlɛn ɓagakǝv dǝ kǝgha, agha ghuda hii vakavaki riigha biya. Agha vai ba dzaha dǝgit vakavaki kutgha biya.
Iin wa gǝdzakut kaiya, ǝn kwaɗa kǝ afka ǝn hǝɗnanna. Na kǝ dǝgagha.’
“Am nǝ dadda hǝnyahaan taa kǝ iina, ‘Kǝgh, kwatnahǝn kǝlaadna, mandǝlghna! Mbats agha sǝrgasǝrǝg taakiya ǝn ghuda hii vakavaki riyana biya, dlaɓa ǝn vai ba dzaha dǝgit vakavaki kutana biya.
Maa fǝghwifǝg kǝ kwaɓar ma banka, maa bad saasar ǝn tlǝkǝna kǝ yu tuuk vakaiya!
Mbakyarvad kwaha, cauwamarvacaug kǝ alfuwa adawan pallna am vǝlar kǝ dadda kwad alfu kǝlaawna.
Aɗaba baɗǝm nǝ daddakwa dǝ dǝgita, da fǝvarnaafǝga tlǝkna baɗyaka. Kwa maay dǝ vakai biya, aanji hǝɗikǝni dǝ vakai nǝ iina, da cauwav vakaana.
Ɓǝlamdǝmɓǝlǝg kǝ kǝlaada kwatnahǝn damma gurtla. Vaakwaha da tuug ǝmtaɗ dǝ ghwada dǝv dǝ tlǝrɗa.’
Tughaha ard aagwaha guja
“Ma Sarti da saay nǝ Zǝra Uud ma ndanngǝraan ǝmtaɗ dǝ zarha ɓǝlga Daadamazhigǝl baɗǝmma, ngal da cihura tǝ avǝd ndanng ma tlǝkǝsǝraana.
Da dzahvant nǝ uudaha duni badǝm da tǝvuukwana, da wahtǝrzha kǝ uudah hutsǝg buwa, bandkwa wahgarzh nǝ dadda piya alman kǝ tughah ard aagwaha guja.
Da dzant kǝ tughah damma dǝvaa kafaana, aagwah da tǝ dǝvaa ghyaɓaana.
“Tǝkalakwah da tagtǝrtag nǝ tlǝkǝs kǝ lii tǝ dǝvaa kafaanǝn taakiya, ‘Asamasǝg nǝ uuramǝn fakura nǝ Daadar kǝ barkna! Na dlǝghamadlǝghǝg kǝ tlǝksǝrǝn ɓadlakurna Daadamazhigǝl bamma fazha duniya.
Aɗaba sarta kwandza njǝkwa nǝ waiya, vǝlamwavǝlǝg nǝ kǝ dǝga zǝga. Sarta kwandza njǝkwa nǝ andǝla, gamwadgǝg kǝ yuwa hǝɓǝga. Ndzan ghulaba, dlǝghamkwidlǝghǝga.
Ndzan maay dǝ sǝɗav biya, vǝlamwavǝlǝg kǝ sǝɗava. Ndzan yang biya, famwufǝg kǝ hyimiya. Ndzan ma guda bǝrfina, nǝghamwanǝghǝga.’
“Tǝhalakwaha, kaa da ngugarngug nǝ uudaha jiijiir taakiya, ‘Yaazhigǝl, nǝghamnd kak hǝr nǝmnd njak wai kǝm vǝlak kǝ dǝga zǝgi? Bii njak nǝ andǝl kǝm gǝgku kǝ yuwa hǝɓǝgi?
Nǝghamnd kak hǝr nǝmnd agha ghulab kǝm dlǝghkani? Bii agha maay dǝ sǝɗav kǝm vǝlak kǝ saɗavi?
Nǝghamnd kak hǝr nǝmnd agha yangbiya, bii agha ma guda bǝrfin kǝm nǝghkaani?’
“Kaa da ngutǝrangug nǝ tlǝsksǝn taakiya, ‘Ba jiir wan tagkur naiya, ɓagamaraɓag tsau kǝ daddakwa hǝɗiikǝn pall ma kwanahaan kǝ zaraabaharna, bakalkal amaa ɓagwi ba kǝskaiya.’
“Tǝhakwah da tagtǝrtaag kǝ lii tǝ dǝvaa ghyaɓaan taakiya, ‘Yagham vakar lii tlafatlafanǝnna, damdǝg damma kaara fai kwa maay ghyinng ba dǝm biya, kwa ɓadlavarna kǝ Shatanah ard zarha ɓǝlgaana.
Aɗaba ndza njǝkwa nǝ waiya, vǝlamwa bi kǝ dǝga zǝg biya. Ndza njikwa nǝ andǝla, gamwad bi kǝ yu biya.
Ndzan ghulaba, dlǝghamkwi biya, ndzan maay dǝ sǝɗav biya, vǝlamwabi kǝ sǝɗav biya, ndzan yang biya, dlaɓa ndzan ma guda bǝrfina nǝghamwa biya.’

“Ghǝravaatǝr ndakwani ar da ngug taakiya, ‘Yaazhigǝla, nǝghamnd kak hǝr nǝmnd agha ɓǝsha wai, bi njak nǝ andǝl, bi agha ghulaba, bi agha maay dǝ sǝɗav, bi agha yang biya, bi agha ma guda bǝrfina kǝm lǝwa kǝ fǝku hyǝmiyi?’
“Kaa da ngutǝrngug taakiya, ‘Bak jiir wan tagkur naiya, ɓagamara bi tsau kǝ dadda kwa hǝɗiikǝn pall ma uudahaanǝn biya, ɓagamwi bi kǝskai biya.’
“Kwanahaan kǝ uudaha, ar da hǝɓa dlaɗ tangw damma zǝrazǝra, uudaha jiikiira ar damma shifǝga tangw damma zǝrazǝra.”
